hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/checkpoint.js"; for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && exec "$d/node" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/checkpoint.js"; done; echo 'handoff: node not found, skipping auto-checkpoint' >&2; exit 0

command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.js"; for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && exec "$d/node" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.js"; done; echo 'handoff: node not found, skipping session-start log' >&2; exit 0
